speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. My wife is concerned about your recent bizarre and agitated behavior; can you tell me exactly what you have been experiencing and how long this has been going on?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details; the belief that the NSA is spying on you and controlling your mind suggests persecutory delusions. You mentioned being withdrawn and depressed for three months and quitting your job four weeks ago; have you experienced any hallucinations, such as hearing voices, or any changes in your sleep and appetite?
